I've got one deal that's still hanging over my head, and I could really use some help. But I'll tell you right now, you can throw your back out in no time doing this! So, I've made contact with the smugglers. Wouldn't exactly call it a partnership, but they've got a decent job for me. We need to deliver some armor plates to their boys. Everything's already packed up and waiting at the drop-off points, so all that's left is getting it to the recipients. You in? Both cases with the armor plates are in Priozersk right now. One's in the bunker, and the other's at the abandoned USEC checkpoint. One case needs to be hauled to the guardhouse at the military base. You want the one next to the trail leading to Woods. The second case is supposed to go in the railcar with the Ural truck at the train station near the water treatment plant. Once you've left both cases at the right spots, let the armored train engineer know.}} ==Requirements== * Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with [[Ragman]] to obtain this quest. ==Objectives== * Locate and obtain the [[Case with goods for the smugglers 1|first smuggler case]] in the ZB-014 bunker on [[Woods]] * Stash the [[Case with goods for the smugglers 1|first case]] in the guard booth near the [[Woods]] transit on [[Reserve]] * Locate and obtain the [[Case with goods for the smugglers 2|second smuggler case]] behind the shack at the USEC checkpoint on [[Woods]] * Stash the [[Case with goods for the smugglers 2|second case]] in the railcar with the Ural truck at the train platform on [[Lighthouse]] * Extract from [[Lighthouse]] or [[Reserve]] through the Armored Train '''Note:''' The "Extract" objective will appear after the "Stash" objectives are completed. ==Rewards== * +28,000 [[EXP]] * [[Ragman]] Rep '''+0.75''' * 275,000 Roubles ** 288,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 316,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 1× [[Ballistic plate case]] * 2× [[Power cord]] {{quote|After a job like that, you oughta spend at least a couple days lying down, brother!
